Mejiro Ryan (School Uniform)

■ Stage Direction
Before dialogue, SE: Faint meowing

■ Stage Direction
"VICTORIA" = From Victoria (Victoria Cup)
"Schimmel" = Schimmel (German for white horse)
"groom" = Grooming

★ Request
*Re-display Mejiro Ryan's model.*

■ Stage Direction
SE: Meowing

★ Request
Fade to black
When my body just moved on its own earlier, I finally realized something.
Phew... There you go. You're safe now.
Um... would it be okay if I just went to check it out?
Wait, whoaaa--?!

Mejiro Ryan gently picked up each piece of clothing,
alternating between quiet gasps of delight and sighs of disappointment.

And in an instant, it began to fall.
The tree was thirty meters away.

Well yes, but... that's not what I mean!
Look, look at the next page!
I'll save you!

Th-the truth is... I'm in big trouble.
It's so bad I can barely even choke down my protein shakes!

I was so happy to go shopping with you and buy cute clothes...
but something just didn't feel right.

Ruffled blouses are McQueen's thing, aren't they?
Maybe I'll just hold it up against myself...
The splendid... Mejiro family's... young... la... dy...
I helped Mejiro Ryan up and took the kitten, but—
My quads are way too big, so it probably won't suit me... right?

No! At times like this, do a chest press!
...Time to try it on!
...I realized that that version of me isn't so bad either!

Aaah! They're totally gonna expect me to play the violin by a window
or something...! Just like McQueen!
Ugh... um...
...Heheh. Guess it can't be helped.

Eep! A tulle miniskirt! With a ribbon on the back!
U-Ummm...

...I was definitely trying to be something I'm not.
I was just trying to be like McQueen.
I'm "Mejiro Ryan," not "Mejiro McQueen."
It's a pink knit, Trainer...

Pink...
With pearl embellishments that just scream refined young lady...
Wah, n-no! I was just staring a hole through the magazine!
N-No way, I can't~

I admire cute things even if they don't really suit me...
but when it comes to breaking a sweat, I won't lose to anyone.

Somehow... I'm just so nervous.
My pecs are practically pounding...!

I'd be so happy if they did!
I'll do the interview in my usual gym clothes, then!

Mejiro Ryan was already sprinting away,
clutching the knit sweater she had just bought in one hand.

Hearing what you said the other day made me think.
Even if it's something I've never been good at, I have to give it a shot...

I just got a phone call requesting an interview...
Even though I'm not a proper young lady like McQueen.

Up ahead stood a tall roadside tree, with a kitten clinging near the top.
Its claws were caught on a branch, leaving it dangling in midair.

That's why...!
That's why I need you, Trainer!!

O-Of course! It's so cute, so I'm determined to do my best!
That's exactly why, though...
Make it in tiiime!

It's strange, Trainer.
Right now... I feel so refreshed.

Looking visibly nervous, Mejiro Ryan strolled past the shop displays.
Before long, she took a deep breath and stepped inside.

I tried thinking about my own potential... but I just don't know.
To figure it out, I need to broaden my horizons!
"Splendid Young Ladies of the Mejiro Family: Feature Part 1"!

During an early afternoon break in the trainer's office,
a visibly exhausted Mejiro Ryan dropped by.
I'd never, ever pick something like this normally, but...

"VICTORIA," "Schimmel," "grooming"...
Whoa, they're all high-end brands for refined young ladies!

On the cover was a full-page spread of Mejiro McQueen,
gracefully striking a pose as she sipped her black tea with poise.

The kitten didn't seem to have a single scratch on it,
and was resting comfortably wrapped inside Mejiro Ryan's knit sweater.
With that, Mejiro Ryan timidly held out a magazine.

Just inches before the kitten hit the ground,
Mejiro Ryan caught it safely with her spread-out knit sweater.

Huh? Was that a cat?
Where's it coming from—

On the way home after finishing our shopping,
Mejiro Ryan seemed somewhat restless.
The knit had frayed, likely snagged by the kitten's claws...

As Mejiro Ryan gave her reply, she looked more radiant than ever.
I heard later on that the interview went brilliantly!
Eventually, she stopped in front of a knit sweater on display in a storefront.

Are you mentally prepared, Trainer?!
This is the forbidden mall McQueen frequents...
Tr-Trainerrr...
